decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy moved to the home page in 2024, which signals that early results resolved uncertainty favorably and justify further commitment, and it fits the firm's psychiatric care core at low incremental cost.
Senior living counseling has stayed on the home page for two years, costs little to maintain, and feeds demand into the firm's residential care business, so the option remains clearly valuable.
The sheltered workshop retail shop was promoted to the home page in 2024, suggesting positive results, and it uses existing workshop output at modest cost, unlike the dropped carpentry workshop.
The meal delivery service is only one year old and merely mentioned, so its value is still uncertain, but keeping this small senior-care add-on open costs little while the evidence accumulates.
